name: verify-sdfm-repair
command: node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFileSync} from "node:fs"; import {execFileSync} from "node:child_process"; import {createHash} from "node:crypto"; import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import {serializeDocument} from "../MAMA/dist/index.js"; import {checkHash} from "./packages/raa-sdfm/src/validate.js"; for (const name of ["crate","blend","figure"]) { const path="examples/sdfm-compare/fixtures/"+name+".asset.json"; const text=readFileSync(path,"utf8"); const asset=JSON.parse(text); const baseline=execFileSync("git",["show","a40baa8:"+path],{encoding:"utf8"}); const old=JSON.parse(baseline); assert.notEqual(asset.hash,old.hash,name+": owning repair absent"); assert.equal(text,baseline.replace(old.hash,asset.hash),name+": changes beyond hash field"); assert.equal(asset.hash,createHash("sha256").update(serializeDocument(asset.document),"utf8").digest("hex"),name+": serializer digest mismatch"); await checkHash(asset,serializeDocument); console.log(name+": hash-only repair and actual MAMA SHA-256 PASS"); }'

name: capture-m12
command: env NMC_CPUS=1 node scripts/lookdev-capture.mjs --page sdfm-compare --milestone m12
